last_action: TWO HOUSEKEEPING ITEMS, BOTH TURNING ON THE SAME LESSON: A GREEN TEST SUITE WAS NOT THE EVIDENCE IT LOOKED LIKE. (1) THE RACY You-reminders TEST IS FIXED (4f1cb49, PR #2). It failed ~1 run in 6 under full parallel jest. The reported cause was wrong and is recorded as wrong: moving the scheduleNotificationAsync assertion inside the waitFor made it WORSE (4 in 10), because waitFor polls for a second and still saw zero calls — the call genuinely never happened. Real cause is upstream of the toggle: syncReminders returns early without scheduling for an empty garden, and mount() only waited for the static YOUR GARDEN overline, so under load the toggle was flipped against an empty store before the seed effect landed. One line — wait for the '1 plant' stat — fixes it and restores what the test is for; as written it could have passed against an empty garden, exactly the case where scheduling nothing is correct. (2) AUDIT BACKLOG 30 FINDINGS DOWN TO 17, BOTH CRITICALS GONE (2e8685e, PR #3), via targeted overrides. GitHub's 48-alert headline overstates the exposure: it reads the lockfile without knowing this app's runtime is a bundled JS blob, and nearly every finding is build tooling (@expo/cli, metro, babel, jest, react-devtools-core) that never reaches a phone. npm audit fix WAS TRIED FIRST AND BACKED OUT — it looked better (30 to 16, package.json untouched) but re-resolved whole subtrees and pulled 26 Expo 56/57 packages into this Expo 54 app, including a second expo nested inside expo carrying @expo/cli@57.0.22. tsc, all 239 tests and expo export for both platforms PASSED on that contaminated tree because the hoisted 54 paths still won for the bundle; only npm ci caught it. Overrides are surgical — 286-line lockfile diff instead of 5208, zero 56/57 @expo packages, each major line pinned separately (ws 6/7/8, js-yaml 3/4, brace-expansion 1/2/5, @xmldom/xmldom 0.8/0.9). (3) CI IS ALIVE AND THE BILLING BLOCKER IS CLOSED — four runs with real steps: green at 1m32s and 1m48s, and correctly red on the npm ci failure above. 21 suites / 239 tests, tsc clean, iOS and Android both bundle at 4.43 MB.

(4) Two items needing eyes rather than code: whether 'Water Marcel' still reads off-centre, and whether the Today footer should report state ("you're caught up") rather than count plants. (5) Then: Maestro against the device, TestFlight, Play internal. DEFERRED DELIBERATELY: image-size (9 high, pinned by metro) and decode-uri-component (8 moderate, no patched release in existence) both clear only with Expo 57. decode-uri-component is the one finding that reaches the app, via expo-router deep-link parsing through query-string@7; worst case is the app hanging on a hostile juniper:// link until force-quit, nothing leaving the device. Not worth a major SDK migration before the build expiry — take them when SDK 57 is wanted for its own sake.

blockers.description: The watering reminder — the feature the whole app exists for — has never fired on real hardware. Everything around it is tested; delivery itself is not. Build 55b80f8a makes it observable.

iOS preview build 55b80f8a expires 2026-09-13. It is the only installable copy carrying photo-covers and plant deletion; after expiry a new build must be cut before the app can be used on the phone at all.
